title: The Synthetic ALMA Multiband Analysis of the Dust Properties of the TW Hya Protoplanetary Disk
question: Which ALMA band set best constrains dust temperature, optical depth and beta in the TW Hya disk, and do archival data agree with the synthetic predictions?

data.angular_resolution: Band 4 ~88.1x62.1 mas; Band 6 ~75.4x55.2 mas; Band 7 ~24x18 mas; Band 9 ~434x247 mas
data.sensitivity: 1 sigma: Band 4 0.0124, Band 6 0.0287, Band 7 0.0350, Band 9 ~10 mJy/beam

what.value: Band 4 and 6 continuum images and 190 GHz MFS intensity/spectral index profiles

evidence.quote: We use Band 4 and 6 data in (cite: Tsukagoshi2016) and Band 7 fits image at Sean Andrews’s science homepage
Band 7 fits image at Sean Andrews’s science homepage
we also find Band 9 observation of the TW Hya disk (cite: Schwarz2016) which is low spatial resolution data

what.value: Midplane dust temperature profile Td=26K(r/10AU)^-0.4 fitted from radiative transfer models

evidence.quote: The $T_{d,model}(r)$ profile is obtained by fitting the temperature profile at the disk midplane in (cite: Andrews2012; Andrews2016)
the accuracy of amplitude calibration for ALMA data $x=10\%$ for Band 3, 4, 5 and 6, $x=15\%$ for Band 7 and 8, $x=20\%$ for Band 9 and 10 (cite: ALMATech2018)

recipe.method: Solve I=B(Td)[1-exp(-tau)] with tau=tau0(nu/nu0)^beta; derive tau0(r), beta(r) from observed 190 GHz intensity and alpha with assumed Td
assumptions: Td=26K(r/10AU)^-0.4, d=59 pc, constant Td and absorption along line of sight

recipe.method: For each of 56 three-band sets, range of Td (5-60 K), tau, beta whose synthetic intensities lie within calibration error x of model at all three bands

recipe.goal: Monte Carlo degeneracy and general-condition test for Band [10,6,3]
recipe.method: 1000 random intensity combinations with errors within +-10% (B6,B3) and +-20% (B10); derive properties; +-1sigma ranges for grid of Td, tau190, beta

recipe.goal: Apply to archival TW Hya data
recipe.method: Smooth images to common beam, azimuthally averaged deprojected profiles, derive Td, tau_B4, beta for [7,6,4] and [9,6,4] sets, with constraint ranges from observational errors

evidence.quote: Band \[10,6,3\] set gives us $T_{d,syn,max}$ deviates $\sim21\%$ from $T_{d,model}$ in average within $20~AU<r<45~AU$.
The deviation of $T_{d,syn,max}$ for Band \[10,6,1\] set is $\sim$10%
The 827 points are plotted from 1000 combinations of the randomly generated synthetic intensities

not_stated_but_needed: Disk inclination and position angle used for deprojection
Radial bin width and annulus averaging details
Grid of radii and parameter grid resolution for sensitivity analysis
Grid for tau and beta ranges
Reference frequency nu0 and tau0 definition
Exact archive files or project-to-band mapping
Treatment of beam convolution of Td model (mean beam)
score_reason: Analytic synthetic method is clearly specified, but real-data processing details are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple analytic recipe, numeric outputs like deviation percentages.
